objective: Cheap IC gate for FTDSH and FTDADV then, only if passed, 4 preregistered books (2 signals x {avoid top decile in top-1500 equal weight, short top decile in ADV top 500 with SPY beta hedge}), monthly.

candidates.method: FTDSH avoid_top_decile_top1500_equal_weight, monthly rebalance; built only if the stage-1 IC gate passes
FTDSH short_top_decile_adv500_spy_hedged, monthly rebalance; built only if the stage-1 IC gate passes
FTDADV avoid_top_decile_top1500_equal_weight, monthly rebalance; built only if the stage-1 IC gate passes
FTDADV short_top_decile_adv500_spy_hedged, monthly rebalance; built only if the stage-1 IC gate passes

sources: data/sec_ftd/cnsfails<YYYYMM><a|b>.parquet (scripts/fetch_sec_ftd.py, 2019-01 onward, SEC 404 gaps listed in fetch-summary.json)

feature_v1_ftdsh_ftdadv.definition: balance of the file's last settlement date; absent = 0; PIT usable from the first trading day after the file cutoff (a: after the last day of the month, b: after the 16th of the next month), held <= 25 sessions; FTDSH = fails / latest PIT cover-page shares (dropped if shares missing/<=0, fails/shares>0.5, shares x close outside [2e7, 5e12]); FTDADV = fails x SIP close / dollar_adv_21 (both at the session before settlement); a row is kept only if the FTD price is within 20% of that SIP close; ticker matched exactly to SIP universe symbols; ftd_dummy = 1 if kept fails > 0 (control, not a candidate).

label_v1_close_signal_next_open_fill_ope.definition: signal at close of t, fill at open of t+1, hold to the open of t+1+h (IC gate h=20,60); books hold until the next monthly rebalance

validation_v1_ic_gate_then_screen_batch.ic_gate_continue: for a (signal, horizon) pair with h in {20,60}: 2024+ mean RankIC of -signal is positive (high FTD -> lower return) with Newey-West |t|>=2.5 (lag=h) AND full-sample 2019+ mean RankIC has the same sign. Books are built only for signals with at least one passing pair; otherwise stop, refuted, no ledger.
validation_v1_ic_gate_then_screen_batch.screen_tiers: runbook section 5: K1 (median-offset Sharpe 10 bp >= 1.19 anchor and >= 0.65 stress, 20 bp annual return positive both), K2 (>= +0.05 vs vol-matched S3 both windows), watch_recent; DSR over 4 candidates; stress window from 2019 only

cost_v1_10bp_20bp_borrow3.note: borrow 3%/yr is the conservative frozen level (high-FTD names skew hard to borrow); shorts only in ADV top 500

benchmark_v1_universe_equal_weight_and_s.primary: universe equal weight; S3 K1/K2 thresholds

keep_rule: Books exist only if the stage-1 IC gate passes; then runbook K1/K2/watch_recent unchanged. No sign, threshold, horizon, pool or candidate is changed after seeing results.
